name: Karlinger
beschreibung: Gasthof Karlinger is quietly located in Sölden in the Ötztal Valley, surrounded by the dramatic peaks of the Ötztal Alps. This heritage inn stands out for its warm wood-paneled dining parlor and authentic Tyrolean hospitality. Comfortably appointed rooms provide a relaxing haven after an adventurous day in alpine nature. Guests enjoy wholesome home-style cooking, regional specialties, and a hearty breakfast buffet. In summer, the sun-drenched outdoor guest garden invites leisurely relaxation. Located close to Sölden's cable cars and trailheads, it serves as an excellent base for skiers, hikers, and cyclists.
kurzbeschreibung: Traditional alpine inn and guesthouse in Sölden in the Ötztal Valley featuring authentic wood parlors and mountain views.
